verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents managed, centrally stored app credentials: one-click OAuth and key-based auth for 3,000+ APIs, with token storage and refresh handled by the platform, reusable as 'connected apps' in code or pre-built actions. Nothing in the evidence shows sharing those credentials with teammates or controlling who can use which credential, which is the governance core of this story. missing for 10: team sharing of connected accounts, per-credential access control/permissions, role-based governance documentation, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential

citations.quote: One-click OAuth and key-based authentication for more than 3,000 APIs (use tokens directly in code or with pre-built actions)
you don't need to build any authorization flows or deal with token storage and refresh
connect to any Pipedream connected app
